caption: San Francisco peaks viewed from near Sunset Crater. Hung out there for a while trying to get good sunset and astro photos. Had no idea what I was doing. Read the manual, I guess.
Horsetooth in the summer. I like the colors.

Corona Arch out in Moab. Missed good lighting by a little bit, ended up here on a kind of aimless, meandering run. Big fan of this place, I feel like you could wander for days and keep finding cool things.
More from Moab. I feel like I've seen this picture a thousand times, like everyone who's ever been in Moab took this. Still neat.
This is on the way to McDonald's from Brendan's house. I always think pictures of murals will look cool and 95% of the time they don't. I hope Dogtopia isn't something offensive.
Sea lions on a rock. People paddleboarding. La Jolla's gotta get more affordable. Or I need windfall, I'll take either.

The Parthenon in Nashville. Was there for a conference, had ~an hour where I didn't really care for any of the talks so I walked over to the Parthenon. Turns out it's about 200% humidity in Nashville at all times so I was drenched in sweat from the walk and had to shower before getting back to the conference. 10/10, maybe my favorite place I've ever been.
On the way to one of the paddleboarding spots in Lory. At that bike park.

You can live up there.
It looks kind of nasty though,
and way overpriced.
From Ben's bachelor party. Hickey let me down in beer die.
Surf Divaaaaa, watch for the vanity plate.
This is a bird on a tree on the way up to Greyrock. Was my test hike before Zion to make sure my knee still worked. It kind of does.
